result.summary: A residential intersection with mature tree cover and basic sidewalk infrastructure. Pedestrian safety is compromised by faded or missing crosswalk markings and a lack of clear traffic control for the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are extremely worn and barely visible, failing to clearly delineate pedestrian space to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the side street on the left.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Mature trees and utility poles near the corner may partially block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corner of the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible for the main roadway, which may lead to higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines by moving pedestrians further into the street before they cross.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a sidewalk and a marked crosswalk across a side street. While basic infrastructure like a curb ramp and stop sign are present, the crosswalk markings are faded and the pavement is showing signs of wear.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The white transverse lines of the crosswalk are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to drivers.

hazards.name: Pavement degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven pavement surfaces within the crossing area could pose a trip hazard.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Apply continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility for approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Pavement resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked pavement at the intersection to provide a smooth and safe walking surface for pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a complete lack of dedicated infrastructure, with no sidewalks or marked crosswalks visible. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicles in a residential setting where sightlines are partially obstructed by dense vegetation.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: Complete absence of sidewalks and marked crosswalks forces pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Restricted Sightlines
hazards.description: Dense vegetation at the corner obscures visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the image at the intersection corner

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on at least one side of the street to separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and pedestrian crossing signs at the intersection.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove low-hanging branches and dense shrubs at the corner to improve sight triangles.

result.summary: This residential intersection is characterized by a complete lack of dedicated pedestrian infrastructure, forcing people to walk and cross in the roadway. Dense vegetation at the corner creates significant sightline obstructions for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: The absence of sidewalks forces pedestrians to share the travel lane with motor vehicles.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense, untrimmed vegetation at the corner blocks visibility between approaching vehicles and pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There is no designated or marked area for pedestrians to cross the intersection, increasing exposure risk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on at least one side of the street to provide physical separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove dense foliage at the corner to restore sightlines for all road users.
